hypotheses.C0_tokenization_coverage: At least 12 declared families retain at least eight examples whose prompt continuation and every candidate answer are exactly one GPT-2 token.
hypotheses.C1_broad_competence: At least six families pass the preregistered candidate-choice competence gate.
hypotheses.C2_nonlexical_competence: At least three competent families come from binding, retrieval, composition, algorithmic, formal, or factual-memory regimes rather than local lexical prediction.
hypotheses.C3_intervention_ready: At least four competent families have eight or more equal-length counterfactual pairs changing at most four prompt tokens and changing the correct answer.
hypotheses.C4_instruction_bias_is_not_assumed: Instruction-like and naturalistic families are reported separately; failure of an instruction-like family is not treated as absence of the underlying computation.

C4_instruction_bias_is_not_assumed.reporting: family and template separated; no failed family is interpreted mechanistically
